name: SELECT
description: Activate selection. Prefer the selection argument to select known entity IDs.

name: LINE
description: Draw connected line segments. Send point actions for vertices and Escape to end the chain.

name: RECTANGLE
description: Draw a rectangle with corner, dimension, area, rotation, chamfer, fillet, or line-width options.

name: CIRCLE
description: Draw a circle using centre-radius, two-point, three-point, tangent-tangent-radius, or tangent-tangent-tangent construction.

name: POLYGON
description: Draw a regular polygon from its centre and radius, with a side count and inscribed or circumscribed mode.

name: ARC
description: Draw an arc using start-end-point-on-arc, start-centre-end, start-end-radius, or start-centre-angle construction.

name: TEXT
description: Create a text frame from two opposite corners.

name: CREATIONPANEL
description: Open the reusable creation panel for one selected rectangle, circle, regular polygon, arc, or text entity.

name: PAN
description: Activate manual canvas panning.

name: VIEWPORT
description: Open the active layout and create a rectangular viewport. Point coordinates use layout millimetres.

name: OFFSET
description: Offset selected lines, polylines, rectangles, regular polygons, circles, or arcs by distance or through a point, with erase/keep and destination-layer options.

name: TRIM
description: Trim selected or visible entities. A point with targetId trims one portion; two points without a target create a cutting fence.

name: COPY
description: Copy selected entities from a base point to one or more destinations.

name: MOVE
description: Move selected entities from a base point to a destination.

name: ROTATE
description: Rotate or copy selected entities around a base point using a pointer, configured numeric angle, or source/target reference directions.

name: SCALE
description: Scale or copy selected entities around a base point using a uniform factor, separate X/Y factors, or reference lengths.

name: MIRROR
description: Mirror selected entities across a two-point symmetry axis, with copy/replace and configurable text-glyph reflection.

name: ARRAY
description: Create a rectangular array from selected entities with editable origin, spacing, columns, and rows.

name: JOIN
description: Join connected selected lines or polylines into one polyline.

name: EXPLODE
description: Explode selected rectangles or polylines into simpler entities.

name: DIMENSION
description: Create an adaptive associative dimension or a free dimension between two points.

name: RADIUS
description: Create a radius dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIAMETER
description: Create a diameter dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DELETE
description: Delete the selected editable entities.

name: UNDO
description: Undo the latest document change.

name: REDO
description: Redo the latest undone document change.

name: SAVEAS
description: Open the native Save As dialog for the active drawing.

name: NEW
description: Create a new drawing, prompting to save unsaved work when necessary.

name: OPEN
description: Open the native .lcad file chooser.

name: PDF
description: Export the active layout through the native PDF print dialog.

name: PDFALL
description: Export every layout as pages in one PDF through the native print dialog.

name: ZOOM
description: Set a relative zoom factor using a numeric command input.

name: EXTENTS
description: Fit all visible drawing content in the canvas.
